scope: Native PostgreSQL learned-skill authority and rank-based resource costs; fresh and transferred character definitions hydrate from pinned catalogs.

source_behavior.contract: Type 1: FLOAT rate = pow(growth, rank == 0 ? 0 : startLevel+(rank-1)*nextLevel)/100; DWORD(use*rate). Type 2: DWORD(maximum*use)/100 with source wrap before division.
Skill template start/next levels and resource selectors come from TSKILLCHART; f1stRateX from FTYPE_1ST (34).
Find learned skill; NOTFOUND on absence, NEEDMP before NEEDHP, HP must exceed cost; reject cooldown before charge; successful sender uses actual learned rank.

golden_fixture.note: Synthetic rank/resource state belongs only to a disposable character; immutable catalog values remain original.

implementation.native_cache: CharacterPayload.skill_templates contains only static definitions for the learned set, rebuilt by DeriveStats during fresh load and transfer/checkpoint hydration. It is not serialized as player data.
implementation.authority: A native cast must match the admitted PC ID, OT_PC, channel and current map and find a learned skill; missing skills return original SKILL_NOTFOUND.
implementation.parser: Truncated target lists, trailing bytes and non-finite positions drop before any mutation. Forged native identities/routes are ignored.
implementation.atomicity: Affordability (MP then HP), restored/optional cooldown gate and exact deduction share one character-state lock; character-to-timer lock order matches transfer capture. Frozen/missing state cannot cast.
implementation.arithmetic: Type 0 is free; type 1 preserves intermediate FLOAT rounding and final DWORD truncation; type 2 preserves original DWORD multiplication wrap. Invalid selectors or unrepresentable values throw before mutation.
implementation.wire: No opcode, field width, layout or sequence-format change. Success now writes the learned rank and emits original HPMP fields when charged.
implementation.durability: Existing core checkpoints and final saves persist resulting HP/MP. Learned skill IDs and ranks are unchanged by casting.
implementation.migration: None. Backups, read-only source catalogs, applied migrations 001-021 and database grants are unchanged.

targeted.scope: Formula arithmetic and actual plain/encrypted Map admission/cast gates, HP equality, MP/HP precedence, cooldown rejection, malformed/forged casts and learned rank.

regression_before.expected_failure: Native skill wire: unlearned native skill returns original SKILL_NOTFOUND
regression_before.scope: Previous installed daemon with current native backend integration executable and the same new TCP assertions.

limitations: New native reuse generation is not ported: rank increments, attack-speed/rate and shared-kind delays need the original TObjBase::SkillUse/GetAtkSpeed and CTSkill::Use semantics. Existing restored timers and optional gameplay-chart base delays remain enforced.
Full target/previous-action checks, learning/forgetting/rank changes, active effects, damage/healing and ancillary gameplay remain unfinished.
The no-payload legacy fixture path still assumes rank 1; native gameplay requires a fully hydrated character.
Original client executable not run; packet evidence uses source-derived encrypted synthetic peers.
Initial CHARINFO timer refresh at actual send time remains pending.
Durability is periodic: a crash can lose state after the last committed checkpoint. No historical player rows are imported or invented.
